title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
script:
Nvidia just released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe on Hugging Face.
The open model leads open weight models on the Hugging Face Open ASR Leaderboard for English speech recognition.
It also ties for first among open weight models on Artificial Analysis.
Alongside the model, Nvidia introduced Granary version two for speech training data curation.
Granary version two provides advanced data curation pipelines to build better voice recognition datasets.
Would you deploy this transcription model?
